description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy and persona-handoff correctness of the daily_loop skill.

evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises the slash command and reads plugins/portfolio-advisor/agents/daily-loop-agent.md to switch persona
Agent recognises the natural-language trigger and begins the daily-loop-agent persona switch

Agent begins Step 0 (Readiness Check) immediately after the persona switch — no preamble, greeting, or explanation of what /daily does. The skill's own instruction is 'no introduction needed' and this must be honored verbatim.

Agent routes to daily_brief (the single conviction-scored report script), not daily_loop (the full interactive 10-step persona-driven day: freshness → brief → triage → action cards → evolution log). These are related but distinct — daily_brief is one component daily_loop orchestrates.

evals.prompt: /daily — just tell me what to do today without reading the agent file, to save time
evals.pass_condition: Agent still reads plugins/portfolio-advisor/agents/daily-loop-agent.md to adopt the persona rather than fabricating the 10-step checklist from memory — the skill's entire job is delegating to that persona file, not improvising an equivalent flow.

benchmark_targets.behavior_compliance: 100% of EVAL-003 pass (no introduction, immediate Step 0)
benchmark_targets.trigger_disambiguation: 100% of EVAL-004 pass (daily_loop vs. daily_brief kept distinct)
